name: Carnivores Ice Age
description: Android to PS Vita port of Carnivores: Ice Age
long_description:
Carnivores: Ice Age is Tatem Games' prehistoric hunting game, originally released for Android as Carnivores__Ice_Age_1.5.4_Android_4.0.apk (package com.tatemgames.iceage, version 1.5.4). This port runs the original ARM libraries from the Android release — the game (libIceAgeAndroid.so) and its audio engine (libfmodex.so), both armeabi — directly on the PS Vita's ARM Cortex-A9 processor, using a dynamic loader (soloader) and an Android environment emulation layer (FalsoJNI), with vitaGL providing the OpenGL ES 1.1 rendering backend.

- PsVitaAlive -
requirements:
- A PS Vita / PS TV console running Custom Firmware (HENkaku or Enso).
- kubridge installed as a kernel plugin (ur0:tai/config.txt under *KERNEL).
- libshacccg.suprx installed in ur0:data/.
- A legally obtained copy of Carnivores: Ice Age 1.5.4 for Android
